mathematical_audit.explicit_lift: For unit lambda, exp(-lambda*p*q) is integral and overconvergent, and Fermat reduction gives Phi_lambda(q)=q^p mod p. In q,t coordinates this induces an integral overconvergent lift on u,v.
mathematical_audit.rational_connection: Logarithmically differentiating 1-lambda*Phi=(1-lambda*q)^p exp(-lambda*p*q) gives C_F(dq/(1-lambda*q))-dq/(1-lambda*q)=dq exactly. The connection is rational and regular at q=0, with one pole on the unit boundary.
mathematical_audit.bounded_split_obstruction: If a bounded solution of F(f)/p-f=-q is written f=p^m g with primitive integral g, the bracket F(g)-p*g is primitive. Minimum-valuation comparison forces m=1; reduction then gives gbar^p=-qbar, impossible because d qbar is nonzero.
mathematical_audit.general_gauge: The upper-right equation for a bounded isomorphism to diag(p,1) forces that entry to vanish; invertibility leaves a nonzero constant diagonal entry, and the lower-left equation reduces after division to the same forbidden scalar equation.
mathematical_audit.dagger_scope: A flat lower dagger connection on the full dagger polydisc would have a dagger primitive. Horizontality makes the transformed extension coefficient constant, and a constant adjustment produces the forbidden bounded splitting. This is a global full-disc statement, not a no-go for a nonsplit model on another base.
mathematical_audit.correction_to_standard_lift_intuition: Item380's lacunarity and nonrationality are properties of the standard coordinatewise lift, not lift invariants. What survives every allowed lift is failure of bounded simultaneous splitting and of a full-disc dagger horizontal presentation.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The model supplies no prime-independent actual-family origin or weighted nonconcentration theorem. The fixed-j=1 ceiling remains 1/36 and zero is booked.
